title: SubmitQuery
description: Sent instead of dismissToAddressBar when the user submits a search or a Duck.ai prompt on the searchOrChat step. Native ends onboarding and opens the query in the Welcome tab.

mode.description: Whether to open the query as a search or send it to Duck.ai

query.description: The text to search for or send to Duck.ai, trimmed. A search's "Surprise me!" sends an image search, e.g. "!image baby ducklings"

source.description: "suggestion" when the user picked a suggestion, including "Surprise me!"
